# U47: Someone else, in another browser, opens the inbox with no sign-in, sees a markup sent from the demo with its picture, says why it won’t be fixed and sees who said so

- **Belongs to:** the Feedback module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `CONNECT-CLAUDE`, `MARKUP-INBOX`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `progress` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U47

## Steps and checks

- **Check:** It fails if U47 needs the build with a database address (DOWN).
- _Note:_ Rhea marks up Home in the demo.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- A database for the build whose database never answers (`fakeSupabase`).
- Go to `/` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- Sends a markup of Home from the demo, as the person on this page (`sendHomeMarkup`).
- Close this browser.
- _Note:_ Grace, in a browser of her own, opens the inbox: no sign-in, no token.
- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- A database for the build whose database never answers (`fakeSupabase`).
- Go to `/feedback` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- **Check:** An Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`) with the mk item (`.mk-item`) shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the part `input[type=email], input[type=password]` in the inbox (`#inbox`) is not there (else: the inbox still asks for a sign-in or a token).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the markup from the demo is not listed as New: {rowText.replace(/\n/g, ' | ')}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “inbox”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the open Inbox item in an Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`) with the mk item (`.mk-item`).
- **Check:** The img in the mk layers (`.mk-layers img`) in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) shows.
- **Step.** Press the “Won’t fix” button in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if a markup can be marked won’t fix with no reason.
- **Step.** Type “The strip already says the week on wider screens.” into the “Why it won’t be fixed” field in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the “Won’t fix” button in the mk form (`.mk-form`) in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- _Note:_ It leaves New for Closed, where it says who closed it and why.
- On a phone an open item takes the screen (`toInboxList`).
- **Step.** Press the “Closed” tab in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the open Inbox item in an Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “Won’t fix” is shown in the mark-up’s status line in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: not marked won’t fix).
- **Check:** “Marked won’t fix by Grace” is shown in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if picture shown {shown}, says who {by}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if stored {worked out in the journey as `JSON.stringify(m && { status: m.status, by: m.status_by })`}, pictures read {JSON.stringify(other.db.pictureReads)}, sign-ins {other.db.signIns}.
- Close this browser.
